Terms.title: User Agreement & Terms of Service
Terms.lastUpdated: 2026 Edition | In compliance with the Legislation of the Republic of Uzbekistan
Terms.section1Text: This User Agreement (the "Agreement") governs the access to and use of the AVERON information platform (the "Platform / Service"). In accordance with the Law of the Republic of Uzbekistan "On Electronic Commerce" (No. ZRU-792) and the Civil Code of Uzbekistan, the Platform operates solely as an information and technology intermediary (listing aggregator) and is not a party to real estate rental agreements, a landlord, a real estate agent, or a guarantor.
Terms.section2Text: Registering an account, signing in via third-party providers (Google, OneID), or accessing any catalog services constitutes full and unconditional acceptance of this Agreement and the Privacy Policy. Individuals under 18 years of age or those who disagree with these terms must cease using the Service immediately.
Terms.section3Text: Under the Law of Uzbekistan "On Advertising" (No. ZRU-776), users must publish only accurate, up-to-date information regarding rental prices, amenities, and location. Posting false listings, copyright-infringing photos, demanding illegal advance wire payments, or concealing unauthorized agent commissions is strictly prohibited. The administration reserves the right to suspend offending accounts and report fraudulent activities to law enforcement authorities.
Terms.section4Text: The Platform assumes no liability for the actual fulfillment of rental contracts, property preservation, or the legality of ownership titles. Users are personally responsible for verifying property documents and registering rental agreements with tax authorities (E-ijara / State Tax Committee).
Terms.section5Text: All website assets, the AVERON trademark, source code, UI designs, and database structures are protected under Law No. ZRU-42 "On Copyright and Neighboring Rights". Automated data extraction, scraping, copying, or reverse engineering without prior written consent is strictly prohibited.
Terms.section6Text: To maintain fault tolerance, diagnose technical errors, and optimize usability, the website operates the Yandex.Metrika web analytics counter (ID 112059980). All collected telemetry is anonymized, used strictly for AVERON internal performance optimization, and is never sold, transferred, or disclosed to third parties.
Terms.section7Text: Any dispute arising under this Agreement shall first be addressed through constructive negotiation with customer support. If unresolved, disputes shall be settled in the competent judicial courts of Tashkent in accordance with the substantive and procedural laws of the Republic of Uzbekistan.
Terms.section8Text: The administration reserves the right to amend this Agreement unilaterally. The latest active revision is published continuously at /terms.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy & Personal Data Protection
Privacy.lastUpdated: 2026 Edition | In compliance with Law of Uzbekistan No. ZRU-547 "On Personal Data"
Privacy.section1Text: This Policy is drafted in strict compliance with the Law of the Republic of Uzbekistan "On Personal Data" (No. ZRU-547 dated July 2, 2019). Personal data (name, phone number, email, technical metrics) is processed solely upon the voluntary consent of the data subject during registration or authorization.
Privacy.section2Text: Personal data is processed to create user profiles, facilitate communication between tenants and landlords, and moderate listings against fraud. In accordance with Article 27.1 of Law No. ZRU-547, our database infrastructure is localized and maintained within the territory of the Republic of Uzbekistan.
Privacy.section3Text: Our website operates the Yandex.Metrika analytics counter. All analytical logs (IP masking, click tracking, error diagnostics) are gathered in anonymized form to monitor system uptime and reliability.
Privacy.section4Text: We guarantee that personal and analytical data is strictly restricted to internal AVERON platform operations and is never shared, transferred, or sold to third-party commercial entities or advertising brokers (except pursuant to official judicial orders).
Privacy.section5Text: The platform applies robust SSL/TLS encryption, Argon2 password hashing algorithms, and role-based access controls. Every user has the legal right to inspect, update, restrict, or request the deletion of their personal information.
Privacy.section6Text: For inquiries concerning personal data rights and privacy safeguards, contact us at: support@averon.uz
